responsibility: This file is the master declarative specification of GCC’s target hook interface. Using the DEFHOOK/DEFHOOKPOD macro language, it defines the nested gcc_target structure, the names, types, defaults, and documentation of backend hooks across assembler output, calling conventions, RTL expansion, optimization, vectorization, OpenMP/OpenACC, memory tagging, debugging, profiling, and many other target-specific behaviors; it also synthesizes hook entries for target instruction generators from target-insns.def. Other generated target-hook headers and the targetm structure layout are derived from this file.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative X-macro specification of target hooks—the master list of hook names, types, defaults, and documentation—from which structures are generated, whereas gcc/target.h is the concrete expanded C/C++ interface that includes this definition file to form struct gcc_target and related types.
